title: Per-batch calibration audit and schema fidelity metrics for FP8/INT8 inference
creator: Asha Patel
description: We need an automated per-batch calibration audit and a small set of schema-fidelity metrics that run as part of the quantized model validation pipeline. Current bulk pass/fail checks hide intermittent batch-level regressions in function-calling outputs when models are converted to FP8/INT8. This ticket implements lightweight telemetry hooks, an audit report generator, and a set of deterministic checks that surface: (1) per-batch JSON schema pass-rate, (2) token-level alignment score against golden outputs, and (3) distributional divergence of logits for function-call completions. The goal is to catch calibration misconfigurations and regressions introduced by quantization profiles before they reach canary or production deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A pipeline stage that executes a calibration-audit job per calibration run and per calibration batch
Generated audit report (HTML + JSON artifact) that includes per-batch schema_pass_rate, avg_token_alignment, and logits_KL_stat
Alert rule documented: alert if any 1k-batch window has schema_pass_rate < 99.0% or avg_token_alignment drops > 2.0 points vs golden baseline
Integration with existing CI artifacts: audit artifacts uploaded to S3 and linked in PRs; failing audits block merges to release branches
Bench tests showing < 10% increase in end-to-end calibration CI runtime after adding audit (baseline ~45m)
implementation_notes: Add lightweight telemetry hook in calibration runner to record per-batch: schema_validation_result, token_alignment_score, raw_logits_snapshot_hash
Compute token_alignment_score as % of token positions where function-call argument ordering + quoting matches golden output, normalize for variable-length outputs
Logits divergence metric: use symmetric KL on softmaxed logits over top-64 tokens; store aggregated per-batch mean and 95th percentile
Persist audit artifacts under s3://redwood-ci/audits/{model}/{profile}/{run_id}/{batch_id}/audit.json and index.html for human review
Implement a post-process step that annotates failing batches with sample inputs and PR links and uploads to Datadog (or Console) event stream
Small helpers to re-run failing batches locally via a `ci_replay` flag in the calibration runner to reproduce drift cases
test_plan: Unit tests for telemetry hook serialization and S3 uploader (mocked S3)
Synthetic regression test: create 3 calibration jobs where one batch is injected with a simulated INT8 quantization bug; ensure audit flags it and blocks merge
E2E CI validation: run on runtime-1.20 candidate with FP8 and INT8 profiles for two model families (chat-small, codegen-med) and confirm audit artifact generation
Manual UX check: review generated HTML audit report and validate links to sample inputs, PRs, and replay instructions
Load test: run the audit stage with 2000 batches to confirm memory and disk usage stays within CI limits
metrics: avg_token_alignment baseline: >= 97.0% for golden-matched calibration datasets
logits_KL_stat (mean) should not increase > 0.02 vs float32 baseline
CI runtime regression: added stage must not exceed +10% of current calibration CI duration
